User asked why InvitationsService did not extend BaseService, then required the Controller->Interface->Service->BaseService->Prisma flow to be mandatory with no exceptions, and InvitationsService to extend BaseService without audit events
Correction of an earlier claim: BaseService.findByIds already throws notFoundException on any missing id, so EmployeeController discarding its return value is not a bug. Earlier report was wrong.
Confirmed real and left unfixed per user instruction: OrganizationTypeReferenceExistsConstraint was not registered in OrganizationModule providers, so PrismaService would be undefined at runtime

Backend architecture flow is now mandatory with no exceptions. Audit eventing is the only sanctioned opt-out, via BaseService entityType=null. The auth module is reclassified from allowed exception to known non-compliant pending its own migration task.
AGENTS.md Backend Rules rewritten: mandatory flow, no-exception wording, entityType=null audit opt-out mechanism, domain-vs-audit event distinction, auth reclassified
BaseService entityType param accepts AuditEntityType|null; emit() returns early when null so an entity can opt out of shared audit events while keeping identical CRUD behavior

InvitationsService now extends BaseService with entityType=null; row writes go through inherited createMany/update; removed manual transaction and self-emitted EntityCrudEvent; added createInvitations/markSent/markSendFailed/findMany; prisma kept only for cross-entity Employee read

IInvitationsService now extends IBaseService; InvitationMailListener writes status via the service interface instead of PrismaService; added GetInvitationsQueryDto, InvitationNotFoundException, ErrorCode.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND
npx prisma generate - required because the generated client was stale relative to schema.prisma and none of the Employee-bulk/Organization-FK/Invitation code would compile without it
npx tsc --noEmit clean outside test files; npm run build passed. 12 remaining errors are all in two pre-existing untouched spec files (audit-log.listener.spec.ts, employee.service.spec.ts).

Invitations module now compliant with the mandatory backend flow. Still outstanding for WORK-024: POST /api/auth/invitations/accept, Mailpit in infra/docker-compose.yml, .http files for new endpoints.

OrganizationTypeListPage: added Actions column with per-row MUI DeleteIcon opening the shared ConfirmDialog; added rowToDelete state so row and bulk paths share one dialog; ids captured once at confirm time; deleted row removed from checkedIds; colSpan 5 to 6
Spec sync: docs/07-frontend/pages/organization-type-list.md documents the actions column, rowToDelete state, both delete flows, and the rule that no delete API call happens before confirmation
npm run build passed with only the pre-existing Vite large-chunk warning

Per-row delete with confirmation shipped. Flagged to user but not acted on: backend DELETE /api/organization-types does not yet translate Prisma P2003 restrict errors into a clean 409/400, so the popup may surface a raw error.

npm run build passed after API error toast and fieldErrors hook wiring; Vite reported only chunk-size warning
User asked to move the access token from localStorage to a cookie with an expiry, and to encrypt it on write and decrypt on read

Agent flagged that client-side encryption is obfuscation only because the key must ship in the JS bundle, and offered three options. User chose cookie with expiry and no encryption. Real mitigation (backend-set httpOnly cookie) recorded as a pending decision instead.

token-storage.ts rewritten to use an expiring cookie; expiry derived from the JWT exp claim without signature verification; Path=/, SameSite=Strict, Secure only on HTTPS; short fallback lifetime when exp is unusable

Spec sync: auth-provider.md Token Storage rewritten for the cookie, added Pending Decisions for the httpOnly option and the rejected client-side encryption, corrected the stale Ambiguities note; WORK-000 decision 4 amended to record the storage-medium change without reversing no-auth-cookie
npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build passed (built in 5.78s); grep confirms no remaining localStorage usage in frontend src
memory.md updated with the cookie token-storage rules and the rejected-encryption rationale
Token storage now an expiring cookie. Residual accepted risk: cookie is not httpOnly so it remains script-readable, same exposure as localStorage had.
Added shared RequiredHeader markers to required many-row form headers and changed Employee bulk phone inputs to number
npm run build passed after required header markers and phone number input changes; Vite reported only chunk-size warning

User asked to analyse whether bulk validators can return granular field paths like items.0.employeeCode and whether it can live in one shared file; then approved implementing it and asked to record the format convention in memory

Keep array-level constraints (one batched query, can see sibling rows) and give them a reporting channel, rather than moving to per-item validators which would cause N+1 queries and miss in-request duplicates
Added common/validators/bulk-field-error-collector.ts: WeakMap keyed by DTO instance, recordBulkFieldError + drainBulkFieldErrors, reusable by any create-many/update-many endpoint
validation-exception-factory.ts merges recorded granular paths and drops the superseded coarse items entry

employee-bulk-dto.validator.ts: all five bulk constraints now report items.<index>.<field> paths; duplicate detection returns every repeat index; DB-uniqueness matches employeeCode and email independently via per-field index maps
Fixed a pre-existing row-attribution bug: the old items.find(code match OR email match) blamed the first row matching either field, misreporting when one row collides on code and another on email

Caught and fixed a bug introduced during this change: querying with lower-cased values would miss rows because PostgreSQL IN is case-sensitive; now queries with submitted casing and uses lowered maps only for in-memory index lookup
npx tsc --noEmit clean outside pre-existing test files; npm run build passed

memory.md gained a required Bulk API Validation Error Format section; error-response.md gained Bulk Endpoint Field Error Paths; bulk-create/bulk-update specs corrected from items[n] notation to the real items.0 dot paths
Granular bulk field paths implemented and reusable. Scope limit recorded: applies to 400 VALIDATION_ERROR only; 409 from a DB unique constraint carries no row index.
Recorded frontend preferences: close confirm dialog on API failure and use fixed viewport-relative page/table heights with h-[calc(100vh-numpx)] style offsets
Converted durable project memory from docs/09-workflow/memory.md to structured docs/09-workflow/memory.yaml and updated active references
User asked, as Solution Architect, to inspect the repo and produce a full spec set so three AI agents can build a configurable Workflow Module in parallel

Inspected modules, prisma schema, BaseService, IBaseService, PrismaService, app.module, common helpers/guards/constants, pagination DTOs, invitations event+listener pattern, organization-type module pattern

Inspected AppLayout (Navbar/UserMenu/Sidebar in one file), routes and RouteHandle, shared api/components/hooks, store slices, organization React Flow + dagre pattern, organization-type feature pattern

Gap A: no manager/lead/head field on Employee or Organization and no level/rank on OrganizationType, so approver identity is unanswerable as a person lookup. Authority must be organization-scoped via Organization.parentId ancestry plus organizationTypeId match.
Gap B: BaseService holds one Prisma delegate and has no transaction-aware method; zero existing \ usages in src. Atomic history+request+notification write needs a sanctioned narrow \ exception.

Conflict hotspot: Navbar, UserMenu and Sidebar are all defined inside frontend/src/layouts/AppLayout.tsx, the file where the Notification Bell and new sidebar items must go. Also RouteHandle.sidebarActiveKey is a closed literal union that must be widened.

Added workflow_requests.revision as an optimistic-lock token beyond the brief field list, because concurrency safety cannot be met without a version token. Recorded as Tech Lead decision, flagged for confirmation.

Step chain constrained to a linked list (one child per step) because FEEDBACK is defined as down exactly one level, which is ambiguous in a branching tree. Enforced by the replace-chain API assigning parent_id from array order.

Workflow entities opt out of shared audit log via BaseService entityType null, since workflow_histories is already a richer immutable trail; nothing added to AuditEntityType/AuditAction/AuditLogListener

Conflict elimination: Agent 1 owns and single-pass edits schema.prisma, app.module.ts, error-code.constant.ts and app.exception.ts including Agent 2 entries, leaving workflow.module.ts as the only file needing a manual touch at integration
